title: Ademude a Ɛmemee Wɔ Ahantan Ase
intro: Fa no sɛ wugyina ahonyade akuwakuw a ɛsõ araa ma sɛ wosoa nsafe no ara kwa a, ɛbɛma ankorankoro kuw bi a wɔn ho yɛ den abrɛ. Atwa wo ho ahyia no, nne ahorow hyɛ ahobrɛase ne nkae ho nkuran, nanso ahantan nyin yɛ den sen aseda. Dɛn na ɛba bere a ayamye bɛyɛ sɔhwɛ na ahantan hyɛ nea ebefi mu aba no ano no?
clues: Na mefiri Musa nkurɔfoɔ no mu, nanso mebuu wɔn mmara so.
Wɔmaa me ademude a ɛsõ araa ma na nsafe a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no bɛma mmarima a wɔn ho yɛ den kuw bi ayɛ adesoa.
Me nkurɔfoɔ tuu me fo sɛ mma ɛnsɛ sɛ m’ani nnye na menhwehwɛ Daankwamma a me werɛ mfiri me kyɛfa wɔ wiase yi mu.
Mekae sɛ nea mewɔ no, nimdeɛ a mewɔ nkutoo nti na wɔde maa me.
Mede ahosiesie dii me nkurɔfo anim, na wɔn a wɔpɛ wiase asetra no pɛe sɛ wobenya nea na mewɔ no.
Asase no menee me kaa me tenabea ho, na obiara antumi mmoa me na saa ara nso na mintumi mmoa me ho.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
